home.heroSubtitle: History, heritage, and genealogy of the Gohil Vansh
home.heroCopy: A dedicated digital archive — where history is preserved with evidence and family memories with documentation.
home.heritageSubtitle: Courage carved in stone, memory alive in traditions, and pride preserved across generations.
home.imgCaption: A verified archival image will be added here
home.eklingBody: Mewar's architectural traditions and religious centres have deeply shaped Rajasthan's history, art, and community memory. Kul-Kirti carries these verified sources, records, and family documents to future generations.
home.pratapBody: A figure symbolising freedom, self-respect, and resistance in Mewar's history.
home.chittorBody: Rajasthan's long historical journey recorded in forts, pillars, and inscriptions.
home.portal1Body: Search approved records for your Gotra, village, and family branch.
home.portal2Body: Explore source-referenced family relationships and generations.
home.portal3Body: Submit your family details for review and verification.

history.hero: A careful historical study based on documents, inscriptions, and traditions.
history.introBody: The names Guhil, Guhilot, Gohil, and Gehlot appear in different contexts across periods and regions. Understanding this history requires careful reading of inscriptions, literary sources, architecture, and oral traditions.
history.ch1Body: Study of archival references associated with the name Guhila and their contexts.
history.ch2Body: Regional and historical usages will not be presented as one definitive genealogical claim.
history.ch3Body: Documentation of regions connected with Mewar and evolving community memories.
history.ch4Body: Every published historical claim will include its reference, source, and verification status.
history.aside1Body: Traditional accounts and documented historical facts will be clearly distinguished.
history.aside2Body: Contact the editorial team to share a source or chapter.

search.heroSub: Only records verified and published by the admin are shown here.
search.emptyDefault: Enter a Gotra or village name to search the archive
search.emptyNote: Only approved records appear in the public search.
search.emptyQueryNote: Check the spelling or try a different name.
search.errorLoad: There was a problem loading records.

submit.heroSub: Your information will first be under review and published only after admin verification.
submit.headingBody: Add as many people as you know — from great-grandparents to parents, siblings, yourself, and children. The server will assign each person a unique ID, and relationships will be linked via the father's and mother's unique IDs.
submit.membersNote: First add members, then select a person's father and mother from the same list. You can add as many members as needed.
submit.submitNote: Every submission is published only after admin review.

vanshawali.heroSub: A secure record of source-referenced family relationships.
vanshawali.treeH2: How will the genealogy be linked?
vanshawali.treeBody: Family details will arrive as submissions from the user form. The admin will review evidence and relationships. Only approved details will be linked to the published family record.
vanshawali.flow2: Unique ID and parent links for each person
vanshawali.flow3: Source and verification status of each relationship
vanshawali.noMembers: No family members have been published in this record yet.

samiti.heroSub: A responsible directory of verified organisations and publicly shared information.
samiti.emptyBody: Committee information will be published here after admin verification and receipt of authorised public details.

admin.heroSub: This area is for authorised administrators only.
admin.confirmApprove: Are you sure you want to approve this submission?
admin.confirmReject: Are you sure you want to reject this submission?
admin.gotraFormNote: Enter history and founder information only from documented sources.
admin.sourceRefsPh: Book, author, page, inscription, or archive reference
admin.membersH3: Add people associated with this Gotra
admin.noGotra: No Gotras have been added yet.
admin.familyFormNote: Fill in the family information first, then add each person as a separate card. Father and mother selected from the dropdown will be saved with their UUID links.
admin.mainPersonPh: The person whose family is being recorded
admin.sourceNotesPh: Which document, family member, or record was the source
admin.familyMembersH3: Add people one at a time
admin.familyMembersNote: To add siblings, select the same father/mother. Check parent links before removing a person.
